_id.description: Unique identifier of the document. Pattern: 16-digit numeric string, unique across the database

recordNo.description: Business identifier of the document, readable by people and unique within the site

siteId.description: Reference to u_mes_mast_site._id: the site the document belongs to

siteName.description: Display value of the site, copied from u_mes_mast_site.name

reasonCodeName.description: Display value of reasonCodeId, copied from u_mes_perf_reasonCode.name

nonconformanceName.description: Display value of nonconformanceId, copied from u_mes_qual_nonconformance.title

itemName.description: Display value of itemId, copied from u_mes_prod_item.description

quarantineLocationName.description: Display value of quarantineLocationId, copied from u_mes_matl_storageLocation.name

placedById.description: Reference to u_mes_mast_user._id: user recorded for 'placed'

placedBy.description: Display name of the user in placedById, copied from u_mes_mast_user.fullName

placedAt.description: Date and time when the record was placed. Datetime field: local plant time (IST) stored with the +0000 suffix

expectedReleaseAt.description: Expected release date and time. Datetime field: local plant time (IST) stored with the +0000 suffix

releasedById.description: Reference to u_mes_mast_user._id: user recorded for 'released'

releasedBy.description: Display name of the user in releasedById, copied from u_mes_mast_user.fullName

releasedAt.description: Date and time when the record was released. Datetime field: local plant time (IST) stored with the +0000 suffix

releaseReasonCodeId.description: Reference to u_mes_perf_reasonCode._id: release reason code

releaseReasonCodeName.description: Display value of releaseReasonCodeId, copied from u_mes_perf_reasonCode.name

releaseElectronicSignatureId.description: Reference to u_mes_syst_electronicSignature._id: release electronic signature

releaseElectronicSignatureName.description: Display value of releaseElectronicSignatureId, copied from u_mes_syst_electronicSignature.recordNo

status.description: Primary lifecycle state of the document

schemaVersion.description: Version of this collection's document structure, starting at 1

createdAt.description: Date and time the document was created. Datetime field: local plant time (IST) stored with the +0000 suffix

createdById.description: Reference to u_mes_mast_user._id: user or process that created the document

createdBy.description: Display name of the creator, copied from u_mes_mast_user.fullName

updatedAt.description: Date and time of the most recent update. Datetime field: local plant time (IST) stored with the +0000 suffix

updatedById.description: Reference to u_mes_mast_user._id: user or process that last updated the document

updatedBy.description: Display name of the last updater, copied from u_mes_mast_user.fullName
